title: JobCreate
description: Request body for creating a new scheduled notebook job.

description.description: Optional description of the job's purpose.

parameters.description: Optional parameters to pass to the notebook at execution time.

JobExecutionConfig.description: Configuration specifying the notebook to execute and runtime environment.

notebookPath.description: Path to the notebook file within SingleStore Spaces to execute.

runtimeName.description: Name of the runtime environment to use for notebook execution.

createSnapshot.description: When true, a snapshot of the executed notebook with outputs is saved after each execution.

JobParameter.description: A parameter passed to a notebook at job execution time.

name.description: Parameter name as referenced in the notebook.

value.description: Parameter value passed to the notebook.

type.description: Data type of the parameter value.

JobSchedule.description: Schedule configuration defining when and how often a job runs.

mode.description: Scheduling mode controlling execution frequency. Use Once for a single immediate execution or Recurring for interval-based scheduling.

startAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp for when the job should first execute.

executionIntervalInMinutes.description: Number of minutes between recurring executions. Required when mode is Recurring.

JobTargetConfig.description: Configuration specifying the workspace and database the notebook job should connect to.

targetID.description: Unique identifier of the workspace or workspace group to target.

targetType.description: Type of target resource. Use Workspace to target a specific workspace.

databaseName.description: Name of the database within the workspace to connect to during execution.

resumeTarget.description: When true, automatically resumes a suspended workspace before executing the notebook.
